name: Quest fail -> retry
description: in_progress + command=fail while attempts remain (< max) -> posted, freeing the agent. The attempt counter is incremented on claim (not here), so it already reflects the number of attempts made; the next claim increments again. Clears command and claimed_by atomically. NOTE: max is a literal (default MaxAttempts=3); rule conditions cannot reference the per-quest quest.attempts.max triple. failed stays terminal (spec) — fail routing goes straight to posted/pending_triage, never through failed.

name: Quest fail -> pending_triage
description: in_progress + command=fail with the retry budget exhausted (attempts >= max) -> pending_triage for DM triage. Value-space partition with quest_fail_retry (lt vs gte) guarantees exactly one fires. Clears command and claimed_by atomically.
